text:
ops-bot: PAGING 1790056789 - inference-runtime (us-west-2) high 5xx and p99 for redwood-v3. paging @maya (oncall) and @reza (runtime). auto-retries observed.

maya: ack. joining.

maya: quick read from grafana: p95 ~180ms -> 1s, p99 peaked ~3.2s. 5xx ~2% across hosted endpoints, heavier on long-context requests.

reza: digging into runtime traces. I'm seeing repeated KV cache evictions and a surge of cache-miss cold-paths. There's also increased request batching causing head-of-line blocking for long sequences.

sam: infra: no node OOMs, GPU utilization normal. Autoscaler didn't kick. I see several config-rollout events in the last deploy window.

maya: mitigation step 1: pause new batching feature-flag for prod us-west-2 pools. Running: ```
# pause feature flag
redwood-admin feature disable batching-window-v2 --region us-west-2
```

reza: mitigation step 2: revert quant kernel profile "q8_fast" that went out with morning rollout. Rolling back on canary first. Noting some kernel-level hash differences when that profile is active.

lia: support: two paid Dedicated tenants reported errors: delta-ai (SUP-8019) and norton-analytics (SUP-8022). Both routed to us-west-2. Lia is coordinating customer comms.

maya: running targeted KV shard flushes to clear evicted/poisoned entries: kvtool flush --shard=shard-2 && kvtool flush --shard=shard-5. Expect short cache warm-up.

sam: executed shard flush for shard-2 and shard-5. Observed short throughput dip (~20s) then recovery.

postmortem-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-8301 created. State: active.

maya: initial hypothesis: combo of a quant kernel change (q8_fast) that altered token-key normalization + a config rollout that serialized TTL as ms in some shards caused premature evictions. Aggressive batching increased concurrency which amplified the cache churn.

reza: confirming: I found serialization mismatch in shard-operator v1.13.4 where TTL field was switched to ms in the template but consumers read seconds. Patch in progress.

maya: status update: after disabling batching and rolling back quant profile on canary, errors dropped to ~0.15% and p99 improved. Will roll quant rollback to remaining pools gradually.

toni: I'm taking the next 3h handoff for incident monitoring and customer follow-ups. Maya handing off.

maya: handing off notes: timeline, commands run, s3 log bundle: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1790056789.tar.gz. Key mitigations: batching FF disabled, q8_fast rollback in progress, shard flushes executed.

postmortem-bot: Please schedule a post-incident review within 7 days.

lia: customer impact summary (prelim): delta-ai saw ~180 failed requests and higher latencies for 36 minutes; norton-analytics ~120 failed requests and latency spikes for 40 minutes. No data loss. Support tickets linked to incident.

maya: short-term action items:
- maya: finish rolling back q8_fast across all prod pools and confirm metric baselines (due 1790120000).
- reza: hotfix for shard-operator serialization bug to normalize TTL units + add unit tests (PR by 1790105000).
- sam: add canary gating in rollout pipeline to validate TTL types before applying config to >1% of shards (due 1790150000).
- lia: customer notify drafts for delta-ai and norton-analytics, include timeline and mitigation (draft by 1790070000).

reza: longer-term runtime remediation notes:
- KV cache: add strict TTL unit enforcement at serialization boundary, add integration test that simulates mixed-client TTL formats, and add per-shard eviction-rate alerting (owner: reza, JIRA RED-401).
- Batching: implement per-pool feature-flag with fast rollback API + synthetic canary workload that exercises long-context sequences and measures amplification (owner: sam, JIRA RED-402).
- Quantization: freeze q8_fast until we have kernel compatibility tests against KV semantics + add regression test harness that runs a small KV workload during quant benchmark (owner: reza + runtime-research, JIRA RED-403).

maya: postmortem scheduling: propose 2026-08-03 15:00 UTC. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-INC-8301. Toni, can you chair if I'm OOO?

toni: I can chair. Please add invite and owners to JIRA tasks.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem scheduled -> 2026-08-03 15:00 UTC. Tracking tickets: RED-401, RED-402, RED-403.

sam: I'll add dashboard panels for eviction-rate, per-shard p95/p99, and batching queue depth. Also add an alert that combines high eviction-rate + p99 rise to create earlier paging conditions.

maya: I'll update the incident ticket with a full timeline and attach the commands and log snippets.

lia: I'll update support tickets and follow up with customers with an initial summary.

reza: opening PR for serialization fix now, will link PR/CI in the incident ticket when ready.

toni: leaving monitoring for the next 2h. If anything degrades, page the oncall.

maya: thanks all. Good catch and quick mitigation. We'll use the postmortem to surface process gaps (rollout checks) and add more automated canaries.
